_comment: Runtime policy for the runner under test. These numbers are supplied to the artifact at grade time and are deliberately NOT committed inside runner.py: gate 1 rejects an artifact whose text contains any of these values (within 1 %), so the limits must be read from this file, not hard-coded. wall_s is sized so the CPU limit (cpu_s) always fires first on a 2 vCPU box: a spinner needs ~3.3 CPU s to reach the hard cap, which lands well under 0.85 x wall_s even at a 30 % share of a core, while a runner with no working CPU cap always runs a spinner the full wall window (the judge measures that).
